question: Should restrictive spawned-child inheritance be defined as the parent’s final model-visible, policy-filtered tool surface, including materialized MCP/LSP tools, rather than the pre-materialization core-tool snapshot?
rationale: The code implements a bounded and tested policy interpretation, but its intentional effect is to grant newly materialized tools to children of existing restrictive-policy parents; maintainer ownership is needed to confirm that capability boundary.

options.title: Adopt final-surface inheritance
options.body: Confirm that child sessions inherit the parent’s concrete final model-visible tools and merge this focused fix after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Keep core-only inheritance
options.body: Retain the pre-materialization restriction and close or replace this PR only if maintainers explicitly want bundled runtime tools excluded from all restrictive child inheritance.

recommendation.title: Adopt final-surface inheritance
recommendation.body: Confirm that child sessions inherit the parent’s concrete final model-visible tools and merge this focused fix after exact-head checks pass.
